Use the reel’s handle to cast your line into the water and retrieve your catch smoothly. After use, rinse the reel with fresh water to remove any salt or debris, especially if used in saltwater environments.

Care instructions

Regularly clean the reel by rinsing it with fresh water and wiping it dry to prevent corrosion. Avoid exposing the reel to extreme temperatures or harsh chemicals. Periodically lubricate moving parts following the manufacturer’s guidelines to maintain smooth operation. Store the reel in a cool, dry place when not in use to prolong its lifespan.
